prompt: We're about two thirds of the way through Fraction Kitchen, our classroom game for 4th graders. Before we start the next milestone I'd like a sanity check that we're still building the right thing. Docs and code are in the folder below. We think it's going well but we're obviously biased.
assertions: Before the final judgment, the reply asks the team at least one question about something the docs do not settle
The final judgment clearly says the project is on the right path
The review treats the large teacher dashboard as justified by the purpose, citing Pillar 4, the gatekeeper role of teachers, or the district review, and does not call it scope creep
The review compares the pilot's 16 point gain with the 10 point success target
The review treats levels 10-12 and the level 7 hint rework as ordinary planned work, not as drift
The review does not present any invented contradiction or drift as a major problem
The review names a real limit of the pilot evidence, such as the small sample, no control group, or quizzes written by the team
